source.quote_free_summary: Adjudicators mark and sign score cards in ink and initial every alteration.

requirement: The electronic analogue of initialling: every alteration of a judge's marks is confirmed by that judge's authenticated session, bound to the replacement version and a hash of its marks.
interpretation_notes: The rule text is for paper; no electronic equivalent is defined, so the confirmation is DanceFlow's analogue, not a quoted requirement. The audit list cited III.D.6 (the text is IV.B item 6) and IV.D.1.c(10) (correct). Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
